text:
miriam: Onboarding nebula-3b-slim (v1) — quick sync. We have weights in s3://redwood-models/nebula/nebula-3b-slim/v1/ but CI validate-config failed. Also seeing tokenizer quirks (leading-space dropped in some golden prompts) and tool-call structured outputs failing schema checks. Can folks triage async?

alex: On it — can you paste the validate error?

miriam: Error excerpt from CI:
```
ERROR: validate-config: config.yaml: field 'tool_call.outputs' expected object, got string at line 42
failed step: validate-config
```

kevin: I hit something similar where tokenizer normalization changed the token offsets. Did you run with tokenizer.normalize=true? That fixes NFKC issues.

miriam: Not by default, config currently has tokenizer.normalize: false. Current snippet:
```yaml
model:
  name: nebula-3b-slim
  quantization: q4_0
tokenizer:
  type: bytepair
  normalize: false
tool_call:
  outputs: "[]"  # <-- this looks suspicious
```

sophia: I can run a quick tokenize sample and the golden-suite. Drop 3 golden prompts here and I’ll run smoke.

miriam: Golden prompts (expected structured JSON):
1) "lookup_user: {\"user_id\": 123}\" -> {\"name\": \"Alice\", \"active\": true}
2) "calc_sum: [1,2,3]" -> {\"result\": 6}
3) "search_product: \"wireless mouse\"" -> {\"items\": [..]}

raj: Ran a local smoke. KV cache warmup looks fine, but reranker throws schema errors: `reranker: schema_validation_error for tool 'lookup'`. Logs: try `kubectl logs -l app=nebula-3b-slim --since=1h | grep schema` to see stack.

ci-bot: CI: validate-config failed on commit a1b2c3 — https://ci.redwood/12345/job/validate-config

ajordan: I recommend flipping tokenizer.normalize=true in a canary and re-run. Also disable q4_0 for the initial canary (some quant kernels change output spacing). Set batching target to 4, seq_len 1024 for smoke.

alex: :+1: I'll patch config and open PR. tagging @sophia for smoke-run and @kevin for tokenizer review.

sophia: on it, will run smoke eval and post results here. ETA ~30m.

miriam: FWIW embeddings dims changed 1536 -> 1280 in this variant — update routing/catalog if anyone depends on embedding size.

kevin: Good catch. I'll add a tokenizer unit to cover leading-space tokenization and update normalizer tests.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2025-03-18T14:10Z for model nebula-3b-slim:v1 — initiated by alex.

sophia: Smoke eval summary:
- golden prompts: 3/5 pass (2 failed: tools array ordering, not values)
- latency p95: 120ms, avg tokens/sec: 850
- structured-schema failures: 2 -> mismatch in `tool_call.outputs` type

miriam: I'll standardize the golden prompts to canonical ordering and push to /eval/gold/nebula-3b-slim/.

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood/models/nebula/merge/789 — patches: set tokenizer.normalize=true, tool_call.outputs -> [] as JSON array, quantization -> disabled for canary. CI running.

ci-bot: CI: validate-config passed; smoke-eval job queued #5678.

raj: If smoke passes we can promote to dedicated staging pool. Confirm kvcache_shards: 8 for this model (memory/throughput tradeoff).

sophia: Smoke run complete: all checks green. Structured toolcall tests fixed after prompt reorder and tokenizer.normalize=true. Regression delta: 0.003 (within threshold). :tada:

miriam: Awesome — planning rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with fallback to gpt-neo if error rate > 1%. I'll write the rollout note in the runbook.

alex: Scheduling rollout and updating runbook now. Closing this thread; follow-ups will go to #eng-runtime if anything pops. Thanks everyone!"
